original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚卡诺州警方逮捕一名被通缉的流氓嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 卡诺州警察局逮捕了一名25岁嫌疑人乌马尔·乌斯曼，据称其涉嫌在里明凯贝地区从事流氓活动、抢劫手机并袭击安全人员。警方称该嫌疑人此前已被列入通缉名单，经数周监控和情报收集后于周四晚将其抓获。目前该信息仅来自警方单方面声明，属单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州警察局逮捕25岁嫌疑人乌马尔·乌斯曼
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kano State Police Command has arrested a 25-year-old suspected thug, Umar Usman

key_facts.fact: 该嫌疑人被指涉嫌流氓活动、抢劫手机及袭击安全人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: over alleged involvement in thuggery, mobile phone robberies and attacks on security personnel in Rimin Kebe and its environs

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人此前已被列入警方通缉名单
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect had been on the command’s wanted list over alleged involvement in criminal activities in the area

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人于周四晚约8时40分被抓获
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The suspect was arrested at about 8.40pm on Thursday by surveillance operatives attached to Zango Police Division
